observation: The crossed composite sign is visible in both witnesses and supports the current transcribed special form. No independently bounded earlier e or later overstroke order can be separated, so an e-to-l correction is not recovered.

The crowded final cluster contains overlapping strokes but neither witness isolates a complete underlying a or fixes a later s as a separate physical phase. Crowding and compound pen motion remain viable.

Both unusual plumed compound forms are visible but the plume is not physically separable as a later stroke and no erased unplumed ch state remains. They can only be retained as sh-like glyph variants rather than recovered ch-to-sh edits.
